fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. 1. Original notarized certificate of guardian in Beijing. Applicants under the age of 18 by September 1, 2025, must submit the original notarial certificate of guardian issued by the local notary office. If applicants apply for a major taught on the Beijing Campus, a notarized certificate of guardian in Beijing must be provided. If applicants apply for a major taught on Zhuhai Campus, a notarized certificate of guardian in Guangdong province must be provided. * 2. The original or notarized certificate of high school diploma Graduated applicants should provide the initial copy of the high school graduation certificate or a notarial certificate; applicants who apply before graduation should provide the original copy of expected graduation certificate. In the latter case, please bring the original diploma or the notarial certificate to the campus at the registration. Applicants who fail to provide the materials mentioned above will have their admission to the university canceled. Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 3. The original transcript of all courses in high school Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 4. Photocopies of HSK Certificate and transcript. The exam date on the HSK certificate should be no earlier than November 1, 2022. * 5. A letter of recommendation from a teacher, head teacher, or school leader of the high school. It has no fixed format, but signature of the referee is required. You can download a template or sample from here . * 6. Personal Statement Please download and print the form, personal statement is to be handwritten, typed version will not be accepted. You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Photocopy of the Passport page of personal information. The passport should not expire before March 31, 2026. If applicants have a visa to China, please provide a copy of the recent visa page. Applicants who are currently in China should provide a copy of the valid Foreigner's Residence Permit of the People's Republic of China. * 8. Recent 2-inch passport-style photo (bare-headed, and with a white background) 9. Photocopies of other supplementary materials and certificates Such as award certificates, standardized test scores, and other relevant documents, should be scanned and combined into a single PDF or Word file for upload. * 10. The Certificate of Non-Criminal Record or Letter of Commitment. 11. Other materials If both parents or one of the parents of the applicant are Chinese citizens and reside in a foreign country, the applicant should have foreign nationality at birth and hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years. In addition, more than 2 years of actual residence in a foreign country has been recorded in the last 4 years (ending in April 30, 2025). The actual residence of more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit signatures. For residences of mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan who immigrated to foreign countries and are applying as international students, please refer to the requirements above. (1) Copies of page with stamp of entry in the last 4 years (from April 30, 2021 to April 30, 2025), and original for reference. (2) Proof of study abroad in the last four years. (3) Applicants from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan who obtained foreign nationality after immigration must provide foreign certificate of naturalization, proof of the cancellation of original Chinese household registration and renunciation of Chinese nationality in addition to the materials for the two categories above. * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should observe the laws and decrees of China as well as the rules and regulations of the university, while respecting the customs and traditions of the Chinese people. Additionally, they should demonstrate good moral character, have no criminal record, and be in good health, enabling them to study and live independently in China. 2. Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports, between the ages of 18 to 40 (Date of Birth is after August 31, 1985). Applicants under the age of 18 as of September 1, 2025, must have a guardian in China. 3. With both or one of the parents being Chinese citizens and residing outside China, the applicant who acquired a foreign nationality at birth shall hold a valid foreign nationality certificate for at least 4 years before applying. In addition, the applicant’s record of at least 2 years of actual residence abroad during the last 4 years must be provided (from April 30, 2021 to April 30, 2025). The actual residence of more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year subject to the date on the entry and exit stamp. For residents of mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan who immigrated to foreign countries and are applying as international students, please also follow the requirements above. 4. Applicants should have a certificate equivalent to a Chinese high school graduation certificate or above. 5. Applicant’s Chinese proficiency must meet the requirements of the majors applied for. For those applying for the “Chinese as a Second Language” major and “Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages” major, a minimum score of 180 in HSK Level 4 is required; for other majors, a minimum score of 180 in HSK Level 5 is required. Applicants from institutions that have signed a cooperative agreement with BNU are required to meet the language proficiency requirements set forth in the agreement.
